title: Mamata moves Supreme Court against EC decision to freeze TMC name, symbol
content: Mamata Banerjee has challenged the Election Commission's decision in the Supreme Court. The poll panel froze the Trinamool Congress name and symbol for upcoming bypolls. Her faction received a new name and symbol for the October 6 elections. The rival faction was allotted a different name and symbol by the ECI. The dispute over the original party identity remains unresolved by the commission.

title: RBI has record forex reserves, but why is rupee still not out of the woods?
content: The currency is now hovering back to its two-month lows. While the RBI is intervening to prevent major volatility, the fact is the rupee is still facing immense pressure, and experts believe the currency is unlikely to appreciate much any time soon.

title: 'Fifteen days is a long time': BCCI plays wait-and-watch on Ajit Agarkar's future
content: Agarkar was appointed chairman of the men's senior selection committee in July 2023, and his contract is scheduled to end next month.

title: Meet Dina McCormick, whom Zuckerberg asked to trade her Meta board seat for a job
content: Born in Cairo, Egypt and raised in Texas, Dina Powell McCormick gave up her Meta board seat last December after Mark Zuckerberg asked her to take an operating job instead. Nine months on, the Goldman Sachs veteran and former deputy national security adviser is president, vice chairman and co-leader of Meta Compute, handling the company's hardest legal, political and financial problems as its 2026 AI capex guidance climbs to as much as $145 billion.

title: He wrongly showed Rs 9.6 lakh EPF in ITR, taxman added it; ITAT gives full relief
content: The tribunal found that the addition could not stand in the absence of evidence that the taxpayer had actually received the amount from the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), withdrawn it from his EPF account or received any corresponding credit in his bank account.

title: UN report finds widespread sexual violence in Ukraine war, 89% of cases linked to Russia
content: A UN report documented widespread sexual violence by Russian forces in Ukraine.  These violations included gang rape and genital mutilation against civilians and prisoners.  Ukrainian authorities were responsible for a smaller number of similar human rights abuses.  Most victims of sexual violence in detention were men, according to the UN findings.  The report highlights the ongoing nature of these abhorrent acts amid the conflict.

title: From Macaca to MAGA: How one needling remark can become a political thorn for Trump
content: A 2006 incident involving Senator George Allen and a racial slur highlights how small remarks can alter election outcomes.  Recent social media posts by Republican Bo French have also drawn significant criticism and condemnation.  These events suggest a growing unease among some Republicans regarding Trump's influence.  Moderate Republicans and even prominent figures are distancing themselves from controversial rhetoric.  Such shifts could impact the upcoming midterm elections and future political landscapes.

title: Bristol’s £9.7m Harbour Walkway links Temple Meads to £500m campus
content: Bristol City Council spent £9.7 million on a 400-metre floating Harbour Walkway, initially estimated at £2.5 million and designed to connect Temple Meads station to a planned music arena. The arena was later moved to Filton. The walkway now connects the station’s new eastern entrance with the University of Bristol’s £500 million campus.

title: Washington couple spent $300,000 on home plans; state wants 44 acres surrendered
content: Tyler Chambers embarked on an ambitious journey to construct his dream home in Washington. Investing nearly $300,000 into regulatory requirements and necessary studies, he was soon met with neighbor complaints that triggered additional demands. These included extensive environmental assessments and a permanent conservation deed restriction on two-thirds of his land. Undeterred by the financial and emotional strain, Chambers remains resolute in his quest to build a home.

title: Google cofounder Larry Page’s wife’s company has donated over $120m in ocean projects
content: Lucinda Southworth, married to Google co-founder Larry Page, is a passionate advocate for ocean conservation through her organization, Oceankind. Since 2018, Oceankind has generously contributed over $120 million to improve marine ecosystems and support community health. With a focus on addressing pressing challenges like climate change and pollution, the organization champions innovative solutions and effective policies to protect our oceans worldwide.

title: Assam's 'Iron Lady' becomes first woman to lead CRPF's elite CoBRA unit
content: Sanjukta Parashar, renowned as the Iron Lady of Assam, has made her mark as the first female Inspector General to lead the elite CoBRA unit of the CRPF. With a commendable background in national security and field postings, her historic appointment signifies a groundbreaking advancement for women in India's defense forces, showcasing that roles in frontline combat leadership are now within reach for women.

title: Smooth take off: Pilot handles Punjab turbulence; can he nail the landing for Cong?
content: Sachin Pilot has successfully brought together key leaders of the Punjab Congress, such as Channi and Warring, as they gear up for the 2027 assembly elections. With Rahul Gandhi positioned as the prominent figure of their campaign, this strategic move is designed to counter formidable opponents like the Aam Aadmi Party. However, Pilot now faces the crucial task of maintaining this unity through to the elections.

title: Chelsea Freeman: How did Freddie Freeman’s wife build her own identity?
content: Freddie Freeman’s wife Chelsea Freeman is drawing attention with a recent social media moment, but her story goes far beyond the Los Angeles Dodgers spotlight. From raising three sons with Freddie Freeman to making MLB All-Star appearances and building her own business, Chelsea Freeman has created an identity of her own. Her latest appearance offers another glimpse into her family life, personal style and growing ventures.

title: Terry Bradshaw reveals why Nick Saban had enough at Alabama
content: Terry Bradshaw believes Nick Saban left Alabama because he did not want to keep dealing with NIL, recruiting and roster changes. Saban had raised concerns about college football before retiring in 2024. Since then, he has remained involved in the debate and now supports the Protect College Sports Act, which aims to create national rules for college athletics.

title: Poland joins coalition to strengthen Ukraine’s air defences against Russia
content: Poland has joined a significant anti-ballistic missile coalition with Ukraine and other European allies. This new project aims to develop an alternative and more affordable missile defense system. Prime Minister Donald Tusk also announced a substantial new donation package for Ukraine. The announcement occurred during the first Carpathian Summit focused on regional security and cooperation. Both nations emphasized their strong partnership and shared opposition to Russian aggression.

title: BCCI books separate accommodation for men's cricket team at Asian Games

This decision mirrors previous disputes seen in Maharashtra with Shiv Sena and NCP. The commission is now tasked with determining the rightful claim to the original TMC name and symbol, influenced heavily by recent Supreme Court decisions that prioritise organisational support in addition to electoral backing.

title: NSE IPO subscribed 1.16 times on Day 2 led by non-institutional investors, QIBs
content: The Rs 22,569-crore IPO has become India’s second-largest public issue, behind Hyundai Motor India’s Rs 27,870-crore offering in 2024. It has also moved past LIC’s Rs 21,000-crore IPO of 2022, but remains smaller than Hyundai Motor India’s record issue.

title: Sehwag shines, Dravid goes ballistic as India beat Australia by seven runs

India posted 182 for six after being sent in to bat by Aussie skipper Jack Czosnek, with Chauhan making 54 off 34 balls and Anvay, son of former India captain Rahul Dravid, scoring 38 off 18.

title: India's metro boom: From one city to a network set to overtake the US
content: India's metro network has expanded significantly, now spanning 26 cities.  The nation is nearing the US in metro network length, trailing only China.  This rapid growth has occurred primarily within the last decade.  Hundreds of kilometers of new metro lines are currently under construction.  Future expansion will focus on integration and passenger demand for sustainability.

title: Tier-2 cities see housing prices rise nearly twice as fast as top 8 markets: Report
content: Residential prices in eleven emerging Tier-2 Indian cities have grown significantly faster. These smaller markets are now driving India's next phase of real estate expansion. Infrastructure development and rising consumption are supporting this accelerated price growth. Commercial activity is also expanding across these developing urban centers. Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities are projected to contribute substantially to India's real estate sector.

title: ‘Fully compliant’: Nestlé India responds to FSSAI action over infant nutrition products
content: Nestlé India stated its infant nutrition products fully comply with regulations. The company submitted a detailed response to FSSAI regarding promotional claims. FSSAI initiated legal action over alleged non-compliances with infant nutrition product regulations. A separate sample of a Nestlé follow-up formula was found sub-standard. Three adjudication cases have been filed against Nestlé India for these products.

title: Jantar Mantar attacker Swatantra Bhardwaj released from Tihar on 3-week interim bail
content: Swatantra Bhardwaj, the social media influencer, was released from Tihar Jail after a Delhi court granted him three weeks' interim bail related to an alleged assault charge. The court enforced strict rules, particularly preventing him from sharing details of the case online. Bhardwaj's detention earlier this month followed an incendiary interview. The next court date is set for October 6, where the situation will be reassessed.

title: 'Subah Jalandhar, shaam nu Dilli': Abhishek Sharma's pep talk before 30-ball century
content: Abhishek tore into the Afghanistan bowling attack, scoring 108 off just 34 balls with 11 sixes. His innings took India to 221 for 7 after Afghanistan chose to field first.

title: HAL hands over LCA FOC trainers, HTT-40 to IAF, 4 Dhruv-NG choppers to Pawan Hans
content: HAL successfully delivered two LCA Tejas twin-seater trainers to the Indian Air Force, along with the first HTT-40 basic trainer, dubbed Ankur. Additionally, four Dhruv Next Generation helicopters were handed over to Pawan Hans Limited. These significant deliveries mark the initiation of a new phase in HAL's contract obligations, showcasing India's ongoing strides in indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities.

title: Raja D King’s ‘iPhone Langar’ in Chandigarh: 10 phones and a ‘Jai Mata Di’ rule
content: Raja D King will distribute iPhones publicly on September 22 in Chandigarh. Selected recipients from Chandigarh and Mohali will receive iPhone 17 models. Winners must write "Jai Mata Di" daily until they receive their phones. This initiative follows his earlier postponed petrol langar event. The distribution will expand to ten more Punjab cities later.

title: Nithari case victim's father questions Surendra Koli's death, claims murder

The victim's father believes Koli was murdered and not a suicide victim. He suggests Koli might have been killed if he knew crucial case information. The Nithari case involved the discovery of skeletal remains in Noida.

title: 6-month-old boy mauled by pit bull in Sonipat, CCTV captures terrifying attack
content: In a shocking incident, a six-month-old baby was severely injured by a pet pit bull that escaped from a neighboring house. The aggressive dog lunged at the infant, dragging him by the jaw until quick-thinking bystanders intervened. The child underwent over twenty stitches and was later transferred to PGIMS Rohtak for advanced treatment. Officials are still awaiting a formal complaint concerning this alarming dog attack.

title: Marathi film 'Gondhal' selected as India's official entry for the Oscars 2027
content: The Marathi film 'Gondhal' has been selected to represent India at the 99th Academy Awards. Set against the backdrop of a traditional ritual in rural Maharashtra, this film was chosen from a pool of thirty-three entries by the selection committee. Notably, it is the fourth Marathi film to earn an Oscar nomination, with the ceremony scheduled for March 14, 2027.

title: CJP questions award to Jaipur school where 9-year-old Amaira died

This institution has been under intense scrutiny due to the tragic death of a nine-year-old student last year, who reportedly fell from the fourth floor. Following this incident, the CBSE revoked the school's affiliation, citing serious safety violations, and a police chargesheet has been filed to address the matter.

title: Scientists burn modern papyrus to help read 2,000-year-old Vesuvius scrolls
content: In a remarkable fusion of ancient and modern techniques, scientists have burned contemporary scrolls to unravel the secrets of ancient writings. The innovative use of leaded ink was highlighted through X-ray scans, providing insights into fragile scrolls from Herculaneum. By adapting advanced software, researchers achieved layer separation, paving the way for a more secure recovery of vanished historical texts.

title: ‘Unconstitutional, illegal, undemocratic’: Mamata after EC assigns new symbol and name

title: Pakistan security crisis deepens: Nearly 1,000 forces killed in 9 months

Incidents have risen significantly since 2022, following the Taliban's Afghanistan takeover.  The Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan seeks to unite Pashtun areas and establish Sharia rule.
